selection.duplicate_policy: unique numeric gene-pathway pairs; retain original evidence counts separately
selection.native_universe: missMethyl::getMappedEntrezIDs from exactly the existing all.cpg/sig.cpg and annotation; no result-dependent pathway filtering

limitations: Numeric source identifiers and human pathway rows do not alone prove all members are human; the native human annotation universe determines eligibility.
All pathway hierarchy levels and TAS/IEA mappings are retained for technical qualification; a scientific consumer must predeclare its evidence/family policy.
This resource pin is not clinical pathway activity, an independent replicate, patient phenotyping or N1 admission.
